description: Create an empty media folder. Existing files and folders are not moved. Refused when a folder with the same name already exists under that parent, so a repeat call fails instead of making a duplicate. To rename or move a folder, use update_media_folder. Returns { id, name, parentId }; pass the id as folderId to upload_media or move_media.

name.description: Folder name, trimmed. Must be unique among the folders under the same parent

parentId.description: Parent folder id to nest under, from list_media_folders (omit for a top-level folder). Refused when no such folder exists in this workspace

name: create_media_folder
title: Create media folder
